statuses.label: Needs a second measurement
statuses.description: No second person is on record as having repeated this measurement on ADEME's files.

statuses.label: Repeated, not yet reported
statuses.description: A second person repeated the measurement and reproduced it; it has not been reported to ADEME yet.

statuses.label: Reported to ADEME
statuses.description: Reported to ADEME, which has not answered yet and decides what it changes.

statuses.label: Answered by ADEME
statuses.description: ADEME has answered; its answer is summarised below.

statuses.label: Resolved
statuses.description: An ADEME release covers this point; the release is named below.

statuses.label: For information
statuses.description: Recorded for information: a difference in method or scope, a convention worth knowing, or a question; it is not reported as a defect.

statuses.label: Withdrawn
statuses.description: The observation did not hold when it was measured again; it stays listed so that nobody reports it a second time.
